description: Shows one request's headers, sent data and response body (start of it, if text). id is the n-number from browser_network.

agent.description: Your display name, shown to other agents. Subagents must always set it. Default "claude-d26d".

multiSlot.description: true only when one agent must handle several slots together (e.g. comparing). Normally omit (one agent = one slot; use subagents for the rest)

slot.description: Browser slot 1-30. "3", "slot 3", "browser 3" → 3. If the user gives a port like 14052, subtract 14049.

tab.description: Target tab: number (1, 2…) or ID ("t7"). Use the stable ID when agents share a slot. Required for action tools when there are multiple tabs.

name: browser_network_detail
title: Network request detail
